data.one_liner: Convert enum values to readable strings and back, with camelCase and custom mappings.
data.what_it_does: This package provides helper methods to transform enum values into plain strings and vice versa. It supports camelCase formatting, word capitalization, and custom string mappings for enhanced enums.
use_when: When you need to display enum values in UI without the default EnumName.ValueName syntax
When you need to parse user input or API strings back into enum values
When working with Dart 2.17+ enhanced enums that require custom string representations
avoid_when: When you need localization or pluralization of enum strings
When enum values are dynamic or not known at compile time
strengths: Supports custom mappings and camelCase conversion
weaknesses: No code generation or compile‑time checks
